Inclusion Criteria:
  -  singleton parturient
  -  planned for elective LSCS under spinal anesthesia
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  gestational age < 36 weeks
  -  emergency cases
  -  placenta previa, [OR]  pre-eclampsia
  -  BMI>40
  -  Reynauld disease
  -  patient refusal
  -  cardiovascular disease
